_comment: hubCardTuple's rules (WORKORDER-P7a-rosettaPayloadShape-110926, Q61-Q65): which card edges are the tuple's slots and in what order, which graph label names a part's kind, and which card fields carry a datatype range. Hub-neutral: an edge type is HAS_<hubName>_<edgeSlotName> (toolPayloadContract.hubEdgeTypeFor); whether a hub's range is part of what a card names is read from the hub's own slotProfile, never from its name.
_rangeAsMeaningAddressingName: a slotProfile field carrying this rangeAddressing makes the hub's range descriptive, not part of what its cards name (CTDL today: rangeClassIdList and its siblings)
_datatypeRangeFieldNameList: card fields that hold a datatype range (not an element, so no part and no uri); read only when the hub's slotProfile declares the field
